Absolute Fury.name: Absolute Fury
Absolute Fury.description: Caster enhances the targets with the strength of earth. Willing targets receive a placed roll on all PWR, STR, and AGI checks, gain a 4 + 1/4F bonus martial points, and all evocations are automatically finessed twice in a direction of the caster's choosing for free.

Cloak of Stone.name: Cloak of Stone
Cloak of Stone.description: Caster covers the willing target in a thick layer of elemental energy, damaging other targets within 10' + 5'/2F of them for 2 + 1/4F d10 force damage at the end of their turn. This spell also grants the target force resistance.

Crystal Scales.name: Crystal Scales
Crystal Scales.description: A crystalline, scale-like coat covers the target for the duration of the spell, or until the armor breaks. This armor grants a willing target 4 + 1/2F bonus DVs and 6 instances of mundane damage reduction. The armor blocks all damage until it has taken 40 + 8/F damage, at which point it breaks - no longer providing a benefit (breaking naturally at the end of the duration.) Upon breaking, an explosion radiates around the caster - causing all, excluding the target to receive 4 + 1/F d12 force damage in a 10' radius.

Deflection.name: Deflection
Deflection.description: The caster surrounds themselves with a reflective aura until the start of their next turn. After a creature misses an attack roll against the target, the creature is forced to roll to attack itself with the same amount of energy. Attacks made against oneself ignore Movement DVs.

Demolish.name: Demolish
Demolish.description: Metals from the ground move to the caster's arm, strengthening their punch but making their control unwieldy. The caster can make a melee attack roll against an object (such as a building) or a target with a displaced roll - inflicting 6 + 1/2F d20 force damage on a successful strike, and rendering any armor worn by the target unusable until it is repaired. This damage is doubled against buildings.

Earth Shield.name: Earth Shield
Earth Shield.description: Caster manipulates existing stone, earth, or similar substances to create a mobile shield between the target and others. This shield has a HP pool of 8 + 5/F HP. This effect breaks LOS between the target and others; this barrier does not inhibit the wielder's LOS to others.

Earth Tunnel.name: Earth Tunnel
Earth Tunnel.description: Caster gains a burrowing speed equal to a quarter of their movement speed. Caster can finesse the spell twice to have the opening close up behind them as they move. Burrowing speed is affected by the materials being burrowed through.

Field of Ruin.name: Field of Ruin
Field of Ruin.description:
Caster superheats the ground, causing it to spew earth onto the surface, creating an area of dangerous force terrain. Anyone that falls into the area has the die size of any falling/push damage increased from a d6 a d12. Additionally, the character applies 2 + 1/4F effects to the Field of Ruin. 
Targets selected by the caster do not receive the negative effects while in Field of Ruin, instead, they receive the benefits of Vigor 
Targets selected by the caster do not receive the negative effects while in Field of Ruin, instead, they receive the benefits of Stoneskin 
As a swift action, the character can cast the spell Spiral Spikes (Terramancy -4), originating from any point in the field.

Harden.name: Harden
Harden.description: Caster creates a protective barrier composed of earth and rocks around a willing target, granting them (Rank/2) bonus DVs until the start of the character's next turn.

Ironskin.name: Ironskin
Ironskin.description: The target of the spell gains immunity to a mundane damage type of the caster's choice. Additionally, the targets of this spell can expend a reaction to make a contested STR check to negate one melee attack each round.

Mountain's Might.name: Mountain's Might
Mountain's Might.description: Caster increases the power of the target's physical attacks by enchanting their weapon. The targets have 1 + 1/3F placed rolls on the damage die of all attack rolls made with the enchanted weapon.

Obsidian Storm.name: Obsidian Storm
Obsidian Storm.description: Obsidian spikes rain down upon the area. Targets caught in the storm receive 2 + 1/4F d12 points of force damage, AGI check for half damage and to negate being pinned until the end of their next turn. Additionally, any targets in the area of the spell receive a displaced roll on all HEA checks.

Reduction.name: Reduction
Reduction.description: An earthen aura surrounds the target's body. This spell is cast in reaction to the caster or a nearby target being hit by an attack that inflicts mundane damage, reducing the damage by half.

Spiral Spikes.name: Spiral Spikes
Spiral Spikes.description: A flurry of stone spikes rise in a cone in front of the caster. They inflict 5 + 1/F d10 force damage to all caught in the area of effect, AGI save for half. These spikes remain on the battlefield, slowing all who attempt to move through the area.

Stoneskin.name: Stoneskin
Stoneskin.description: Willing targets receive a 3 + 1/4F bonus to all DVs. Their skin hardens, making them tougher and more akin to stone.

Terraform.name: Terraform
Terraform.description: Immediately upon casting this spell, and then as a Swift Action during all later turns the caster can use one of the following abilities. Suspend and control the volume of earth up to the area in the air and change its shape, by moving it 10' + 10'/F per round. Use earth to attack a target within the LOS by making a ranged attack roll - inflicting 4 + 1/4F d8 force damage on hit. Shape and create structures out of the volume of earth as a Swift Action. These remain in place even after the spell has expired. Walls formed out of this spell have a HP pool of 11 + 4'/F.

Tremorsense.name: Tremorsense
Tremorsense.description: The caster can sense the vibrations in the ground to pinpoint any creature that moves or takes core actions in a 100' radius. This spell does not work on flying creatures or creatures that are not connected to the caster through a completely solid medium. This sense is highly accurate on targets that it can perceive and may replace vision in case of blindness.

Vigor.name: Vigor
Vigor.description: Caster surrounds the bodies of the targets in an aura of force. Targets of this spell gain an exceptional HEA and an exceptional STR and increase their size categories by 1.
